about_blocks.text: The integrated Mental Health and Addictions Program, “Lhet’sut’en” is delivered by our multi-disciplinary team. During the summer months (from May to October), we operate the Ormond Lake Cultural Healing Camp on Nadleh Whut’en territory. Focusing on the holistic well-being of members, this program offers cultural healing combined with Western therapies. Camp themes include “Reclaiming Ourselves”, “Journey to Hope”, and “New Horizons”. During the winter months (November to April), our team visits member communities, offering educational workshops and other support services when requested. Accreditation: The Addictions Recovery Program is fully accredited by Accreditation Canada. This program is a great example of the integration of Tradition and Western treatment strategies, which is reflective of our program’s vision statement: Culture is Healing.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
